label: 导言
titleZh: 一位农民哲学家眼中的西蒙娜·薇依
lede: 这本书不是薇依自己编的。1941 年，被维希法令赶出大学的薇依经佩兰神父介绍，到天主教农民哲学家**古斯塔夫·蒂邦**的农场干活。她离开法国前把十几本笔记本留给了他；她 1943 年在英国去世后，蒂邦从笔记里选编出这本书，1947 年出版。这篇长长的导言既是回忆，也是一份阅读地图。

points.body:
佩兰神父来信说：这里有一位年轻的犹太姑娘，哲学毕业，极左派，被新法律逐出大学，想去乡下当一阵农工。蒂邦犹豫了一下，还是收留了她。

起初两人「友好但不自在」，在具体事情上几乎什么都意见不合，她会无休止地争论。可熟了以后，他发现她 *a charming and lively companion*，博学，会开玩笑，从不在社交上让步，对任何人都说出全部所想。

她觉得在他家被照顾得太好，坚持去别的农场当葡萄采摘工，和壮实的农民一样长时间干活。她头痛得厉害，说有一天怀疑自己是不是已经死了、掉进了地狱：地狱就是永远在葡萄园里干活。

蒂邦简要交代她的生平：1909 年生于巴黎，师从哲学家阿兰，很年轻就进入巴黎高师；中学教书时积极参与政治；为分担穷人的命运，隐姓埋名在雷诺工厂做了一年工，直到胸膜炎迫使她停下；西班牙内战时加入共和派一方，但从不开枪；后来在马赛与家人会合，再经卡萨布兰卡去了纽约，最后到伦敦。

1944 年 11 月，蒂邦才从朋友那里得知，她一年前已在伦敦去世（实际死于肯特郡的一家疗养院，年仅 34 岁）。

她离开前给蒂邦写信：你说在我的笔记里找到了你想过的东西，也找到了你没想过但一直在等的东西，*so now they belong to you*。她允许他读给任何人听，只是不要留给别人。

这本书就是蒂邦从这些笔记中挑选、按主题编排的。所以要记住：**章节和标题是编者加的**，原文是零散的箴言，不是一部论著。

蒂邦概括了全书主线：自然的灵魂运动服从类似**重力**的法则，只有**神恩**是例外；人必须接受**空**、放弃想象性的补偿；自我要通过爱从内部被摧毁，即「**去创造**」（decreation）；矛盾是实在的标准；必须活在赤裸的当下；以及她对体力劳动的灵性理解，和对罗马与以色列「巨兽」的批判。

他也坦白：他是天主教徒，她不是；有些话会让人震惊，比如她似乎把被造世界与上帝截然分开。他提醒，*Simone Weil speaks as a mystic and not as a metaphysician*。

expressions.en: so now they belong to you
expressions.zh: 所以它们现在属于你了（薇依把笔记托付给蒂邦）

expressions.en: Simone Weil speaks as a mystic and not as a metaphysician
expressions.zh: 薇依是以神秘主义者而不是形而上学家的身份说话

expressions.en: decreation
expressions.zh: 去创造：让被造之物回到非被造之中

expressions.en: metaxu
expressions.zh: 中介（希腊语）：介于灵魂与上帝之间的尘世事物

questions: 这本书是别人从笔记中编选的，这会怎样影响你读它的方式？
一个哲学教师主动去工厂和农场干活，你怎么看这种选择？
蒂邦作为天主教徒对她既敬重又保留，这种关系对你理解她有什么帮助？

titleZh: 重负与神恩：灵魂的万有引力
lede: 全书的基本隐喻：灵魂的一切自然运动都受一种类似物理重力的法则支配，只有神恩是例外。卑下的动机比高尚的动机更有力量；痛苦想传递出去，就像水往低处流。可还有一种不靠重量的「下降」：神恩正是一种向下的运动。

points.body:
*All the natural movements of the soul are controlled by laws analogous to those of physical gravity. Grace is the only exception.*

*Two forces rule the universe: light and gravity.* 为什么一个人一表现出需要别人，别人就往后退？重力。《李尔王》是一出关于重力的悲剧。我们所说的「卑下」（baseness，字面就是「低」）都是重力现象。

同样的苦，为了高尚的动机比为了卑下的动机更难忍受：凌晨一点到八点站着不动排队买一个鸡蛋的人，若是为了救人，恐怕很难做到。

*Base motives have in them more energy than noble ones.* 她提出的问题是：怎样把属于卑下动机的能量转移到高尚的动机上去？

这是全书最坦白的一段之一：*at certain times when my headaches were raging I had an intense longing to make another human being suffer by hitting him in exactly the same part of his forehead.*

她承认自己几次屈服于诱惑，至少说了伤人的话：*Obedience to the force of gravity. The greatest sin.* 这样做也败坏了语言的功能。读薇依要注意，她不是在俯视别人，她的观察首先指向自己。

想靠自己的力量摆脱自我，就像一头牛拉扯脚绊，结果跪倒在地。人的道德能量像他的体能一样来自外部。*There is only one remedy for that: a chlorophyll conferring the faculty of feeding on light.*

于是：*Not to judge. All faults are the same. There is only one fault: incapacity to feed upon light.*

最奇妙的几句：重力使事物下坠，翅膀使它们上升；那么什么样的「二次方的翅膀」能让事物不靠重量而下降？

*Grace is the law of the descending movement.* *To lower oneself is to rise in the domain of moral gravity.* *Moral gravity makes us fall towards the heights.*

结尾是一个尖锐的问题：太深的苦难让人落到怜悯之下，引起厌恶与轻蔑；怜悯只能下降到某个水平，爱（charity）要怎样才能降得更低？

expressions.en: Two forces rule the universe: light and gravity.
expressions.zh: 统治宇宙的有两种力：光与重力。

expressions.en: Base motives have in them more energy than noble ones.
expressions.zh: 卑下的动机比高尚的动机更有能量。

expressions.en: a chlorophyll conferring the faculty of feeding on light
expressions.zh: 一种让人能以光为食的叶绿素

expressions.en: Moral gravity makes us fall towards the heights.
expressions.zh: 道德的重力让我们朝高处坠落。

questions: 你在自己身上观察到过「重力」吗？比如难受时想让别人也难受？
「卑下的动机更有力量」，在你的创作或工作里成立吗？
「向高处坠落」，你能想到一个具体的例子吗？

titleEn: Void and Compensation · To Accept the Void
lede: 受苦的人总想把苦传递出去：伤害别人，或博取怜悯。我们伤害别人，是为了填补自己内心的空。复仇、奖赏、想象中的回报，都是同一种「补偿」机制。薇依的对策只有一个：接受空，不去填它。神恩只能进入有空隙的地方。

points.body:
*Whoever suffers tries to communicate his suffering (either by ill-treating someone or calling forth their pity) in order to reduce it.* 这和重力一样不可抗拒。

她对自己毫不留情：*The tendency to spread evil beyond oneself: I still have it!* 苦难中的人，怨气常常指向同样不幸的同伴，这反而成了社会稳定的因素。

*To harm a person is to receive something from him.* 我们得到了什么？*We have gained in importance. We have expanded.* 我们在别人身上制造空，用来填补自己身上的空。

复仇是对平衡的渴望，但 *The search for equilibrium is bad because it is imaginary.* 即使真的杀死仇人，在某种意义上那也只是想象性的平衡。

points.h: 一切奖赏都是能量的退化
points.body:
*Every kind of reward constitutes a degradation of energy.* 对一件善行或一件艺术品的自我满足，也是高级能量的退化，所以「左手不要知道右手做的事」。

路易十四的一个微笑，恰好等于我们付出的东西；宗教在某个层面也是如此：*we invent a God who smiles on us.*

最温柔的一段：心爱的人让我失望了，*Men owe us what we imagine they will give us. We must forgive them this debt.* *I also am other than what I imagine myself to be. To know this is forgiveness.*

修昔底德说，每个存在都会运用它所有的力量。*Not to exercise all the power at one’s disposal is to endure the void. This is contrary to all the laws of nature. Grace alone can do it.*

*Grace fills empty spaces but it can only enter where there is a void to receive it, and it is grace itself which makes this void.*

这需要经过一段*without any reward, natural or supernatural*的时间。*Whoever endures a moment of the void either receives the supernatural bread or falls. It is a terrible risk.* 但她也说：我们不能主动跳进去。

expressions.en: To harm a person is to receive something from him.
expressions.zh: 伤害一个人，就是从他那里拿走某样东西。

expressions.en: Every kind of reward constitutes a degradation of energy.
expressions.zh: 一切奖赏都意味着能量的退化。

expressions.en: We must forgive them this debt.
expressions.zh: 我们必须免除他们这笔债。

expressions.en: Grace fills empty spaces but it can only enter where there is a void to receive it
expressions.zh: 神恩填满空处，但只能进入有空可以接纳它的地方

questions: 你最近有没有因为难受而迁怒于人？那时你想「填补」的是什么？
「别人欠我们的，是我们想象他们会给的」，这句话怎样改变你对失望的理解？
创作完成后的自我满足也是一种「退化」，你同意吗？

titleEn: Detachment · Imagination Which Fills the Void
titleZh: 超脱，以及填补空的想象
lede: 超脱不是冷漠，而是放弃一切想象性的安慰，对现实保持更强烈的感受。依恋是幻觉的制造者；想象则是谎言，它不停地填补神恩可能经过的每一道裂缝。薇依要我们「中止想象的工作」，在空中等待。

points.body:
*Affliction in itself is not enough for the attainment of total detachment. Unconsoled affliction is necessary.* 没有安慰，不可言说的安慰才会降临。

她区分两种放弃财物：为了某种精神好处而放弃；或者明知这些东西有助于精神（饥饿、疲劳、屈辱会让人无法冥想）却仍然放弃。*Only the second kind of renunciation means nakedness of spirit.*

*Attachment is a manufacturer of illusions and whoever wants reality ought to be detached.* *As soon as we know that something is real we can no longer be attached to it.*

*Attachment is no more nor less than an insufficiency in our sense of reality.* 我们执着于拥有，是因为以为不拥有它就不存在了。

一个严酷的练习：想到不在眼前的所爱之人或物时，想一想它也许已经毁了、他也许已经死了，*May our sense of reality not be dissolved by this thought but made more intense.*

*To love God through and across the destruction of Troy and of Carthage—and with no consolation. Love is not consolation, it is light.*

她甚至说：当上帝对我们像宝藏对守财奴一样有意义时，就得坚持告诉自己他不存在，*We must experience the fact that we love him, even if he does not exist.* 这是全书「否定之路」的第一次明确出现。

**内容提示**：本章有一句「两种杀死自己的方式：自杀或超脱」，薇依指的是第二种，即在思想中「杀死」自己的依恋，而不是肉体的死亡。

*The imagination is continually at work filling up all the fissures through which grace might pass.* *Every void (not accepted) produces hatred, sourness, bitterness, spite.*

她举西班牙内战中编造胜利来面对死亡的民兵为例。*The imagination, filler up of the void, is essentially a liar. It does away with the third dimension.* 战争、罪行、复仇，虽然真的发生，却像梦一样扁平。

结论：*We must continually suspend the work of the imagination filling the void within ourselves.*

expressions.en: Unconsoled affliction is necessary.
expressions.zh: 必须是没有安慰的苦难。

expressions.en: Attachment is a manufacturer of illusions
expressions.zh: 依恋是幻觉的制造者

expressions.en: Love is not consolation, it is light.
expressions.zh: 爱不是安慰，而是光。

expressions.en: The imagination, filler up of the void, is essentially a liar.
expressions.zh: 填补空的想象，本质上是骗子。

questions: 「依恋是现实感的不足」，这和我们通常理解的「越爱越在乎」有什么不同？
你能想象「中止想象」是什么感觉吗？试一分钟。
作为创作者，你怎样看待薇依对「想象」的怀疑？想象和创造性想象是一回事吗？

titleEn: Renunciation of Time · To Desire Without an Object
titleZh: 放弃时间，以及无对象的欲望
lede: 时间是永恒的影像，也是永恒的替代品。过去和未来是人唯一的财富，也是填补空的工具，所以放弃过去和未来是第一项放弃。第七章更进一步：要把欲望的能量从对象上撕下来，去爱那个真实的「欲望本身」，而不是想象中的对象。

points.body:
*Time is an image of eternity, but it is also a substitute for eternity.*

守财奴失去的，是一点「冻结的过去」。*The future is a filler of void places.* 过去也一样（「我曾经是……」）。*That is why the renunciation of past and future is the first of all renunciations.*

期待已久的快乐来了却令人失望，*because we were expecting the future, and as soon as it is there it is present.*

*Piety with regard to the dead: to do everything for what does not exist.*

亲人之死带来的痛，是空和失衡之痛；此后的努力没有对象，因此没有回报。如果用想象来填补这个空，就是堕落。

编者注提醒：她说「想着上帝不存在而祈祷」，意思是上帝并不像被造物那样存在，接触超自然的实在，最初会被体验为一种虚无。

*Purification is the separation of good from covetousness.* 要深入欲望的根，把能量从对象上撕下来：*desires are true in so far as they are energy. It is the object which is unreal.*

如果我想念一个已死的人，我想要的就是那个会死的、有限的人，*in that measure we have it*。*When we see that, we still suffer, but we are happy.*

她还有一个关于盲人手杖的比喻：老友久别重逢的握手，我不在意触感是快乐还是痛，就像盲人通过手杖直接感觉到物体，我感觉到的是朋友的存在。

*All sins are attempts to fill voids.* *It is the void which makes man capable of sin.*

彼得说「我永远不会不认你」，这句话本身已经是否认，因为他以为忠诚的源泉在自己，而不在神恩。忠于基督很难，*A fidelity in the void was needed.* 忠于拿破仑容易得多，哪怕要赴死。

但她也警告：*We must not seek the void, for it would be tempting God.* *We must not run away from it either.*

expressions.en: Time is an image of eternity, but it is also a substitute for eternity.
expressions.zh: 时间是永恒的影像，也是永恒的替代品。

expressions.en: to do everything for what does not exist
expressions.zh: 为不存在的东西做一切

expressions.en: It is the object which is unreal.
expressions.zh: 不真实的是对象。

expressions.en: A fidelity in the void was needed.
expressions.zh: 需要的是一种空中的忠诚。

questions: 你更容易用过去还是用未来来「填补空」？
「欲望是真的，对象是假的」，你能在失去某物的经验里体会这一点吗？
薇依说「不要寻找空，也不要逃避它」，这两者的分寸在哪里？

titleZh: 自我：我们唯一能献出的，是说「我」的能力
lede: 世上一切都可能被偶然夺走，唯一属于我们的是说「我」的能力。这是我们唯一能献给上帝的东西，也就是要摧毁的东西。可极端的苦难会从外部摧毁「我」，那反而让人再也无法自己去摧毁它。这一章是全书最深也最沉重的段落之一。

points.body:
*We possess nothing in the world—a mere chance can strip us of everything—except the power to say ‘I’. That is what we have to give to God—in other words, to destroy.* 除此之外，我们没有别的自由行为。

*We cannot offer anything but the ‘I’, and all we call an offering is merely a label attached to a compensatory assertion of the ‘I’.*

*Nothing in the world can rob us of the power to say ‘I’. Nothing except extreme affliction.* 被外力摧毁「我」是最可怕的，因为此后人再也无法自己摧毁它。

失去「我」并不等于失去自私，往往相反。*Human injustice as a general rule produces not martyrs but quasi-damned souls.* 薇依用「准地狱」形容这种被彻底连根拔起的状态。她说，对那些「我」已经死去的人，我们帮不了什么，但我们永远无法确定一个人的「我」是真的死了，还是只是没了生气。

*the absence of God is the mode of divine presence which corresponds to evil—absence which is felt. He who has not God within himself cannot feel his absence.*

地狱反而是浅的：*Hell is superficial. Hell is a nothingness which has the pretension and gives the illusion of being.*

她区分三种痛苦：纯外部的摧毁（准地狱的痛苦）、灵魂以爱去配合的外部摧毁（赎罪的痛苦）、以及完全空了的灵魂中上帝的缺席（救赎的痛苦）。

*The sin in me says ‘I’.*

*Humility consists in knowing that in what we call ‘I’ there is no source of energy by which we can rise.* 我身上一切有价值的东西都来自别处，*not as a gift but as a loan which must be ceaselessly renewed*。

最后一句很美：*Perfect joy excludes even the very feeling of joy, for in the soul filled by the object no corner is left for saying ‘I’.*

expressions.en: except the power to say ‘I’
expressions.zh: 除了说「我」的能力

expressions.en: Human injustice as a general rule produces not martyrs but quasi-damned souls.
expressions.zh: 人间的不义通常制造的不是殉道者，而是近乎被诅咒的灵魂。

expressions.en: Hell is superficial.
expressions.zh: 地狱是肤浅的。

expressions.en: The sin in me says ‘I’.
expressions.zh: 在我里面说「我」的，是罪。

questions: 「我唯一拥有的是说『我』的能力」，你同意吗？还有什么别的？
薇依说不义制造的不是殉道者而是「准地狱的灵魂」，这对我们帮助受苦者有什么提醒？
「完美的喜乐里连感到喜乐的『我』都没有」，你有过这样忘我的时刻吗？

lede: 薇依最核心、最奇特的概念：「去创造」，让被造之物回到非被造之中。它和毁灭不同，毁灭是把被造之物变成虚无。上帝创造世界是一种退让，放弃了成为一切；我们要模仿这种退让，放弃成为某个东西。第十章写得极其温柔：她希望自己消失，好让世界与上帝独处。

points.body:
*Decreation: to make something created pass into the uncreated.* *Destruction: to make something created pass into nothingness. A blameworthy substitute for decreation.*

*Creation is an act of love and it is perpetual.* 我们的存在只是上帝等待我们同意不存在。*In a sense God renounces being everything. We should renounce being something. That is our only good.*

points.h: 我们只拥有我们放弃的东西
points.body:
*We participate in the creation of the world by decreating ourselves.*

*We only possess what we renounce; what we do not renounce escapes from us.*

*He emptied himself of his divinity. We should empty ourselves of the false divinity with which we were born.* 照镜子打扮自己的美丽女人，可能相信自己就是镜中那个样子；丑女人知道自己不是。

*There are only two instants of perfect nudity and purity in human life: birth and death.*

*God could create only by hiding himself. Otherwise there would be nothing but himself.* 圣洁也应当隐藏，甚至在某种程度上对意识隐藏。

本章最后几句后来成为她最被引用的话之一：*We must take the feeling of being at home into exile. We must be rooted in the absence of a place.* 但她也警告：对别人从外部做这些（把人连根拔起），只是去创造的「代用品」。

*Humility is the refusal to exist outside God. It is the queen of virtues.* *The self is only the shadow which sin and error cast by stopping the light of God.*

她希望自己退开，*retire and respect the tête-à-tête*，让上帝与她遇见的人、她看到的大海直接相遇：*If only I knew how to disappear there would be a perfect union of love between God and the earth I tread, the sea I hear …*

*To see a landscape as it is when I am not there …* *When I am in any place, I disturb the silence of heaven and earth by my breathing and the beating of my heart.*

expressions.en: Decreation: to make something created pass into the uncreated.
expressions.zh: 去创造：使被造之物进入非被造。

expressions.en: We only possess what we renounce
expressions.zh: 我们只拥有我们放弃的东西

expressions.en: We must be rooted in the absence of a place.
expressions.zh: 我们必须扎根于无所之处。

expressions.en: To see a landscape as it is when I am not there
expressions.zh: 看见我不在场时的风景本来的样子

questions: 「去创造」和「毁灭」的区别，你怎么理解？
「看见我不在场时的风景」，作为艺术家，这个愿望对你意味着什么？
这种自我隐退的理想，和自我否定、自我伤害有什么界限？（这也是读薇依时值得警惕的地方）

titleZh: 必然与顺服：被推动，而不是被吸引
lede: 阳光同样照着义人和不义的人：上帝把自己变成了必然。薇依要我们爱必然，只做那些「不能不做」的善行。衡量一个行为，不看它的目标，而看推动它的力量；不是「为了上帝」去帮助邻人，而是被上帝推向邻人，就像箭被射向靶子。

points.body:
*The sun shines on the just and on the unjust …. God makes himself necessity.* 必然有两面：被施行的和被承受的。

*Obedience is the supreme virtue. We have to love necessity.* 必然是相对个人最低的东西（强制、力量、「严酷的命运」），而顺服它，在她看来恰恰是最高的。

*We should do only those righteous actions which we cannot stop ourselves from doing, which we are unable not to do*，但要通过正确导向的注意力，不断扩大「不能不做」的范围。

她举了一个惊人的例子：*If my eternal salvation were on this table in the form of an object and if I only had to stretch out my hand to grasp it, I would not stretch out my hand without having received orders to do so.*

一个布列塔尼小水手被问到他怎么做到那件英勇的事，回答说：*‘There was nothing else for it’*，薇依称之为最纯粹的英雄主义。

points.h: 不是为了上帝，而是在基督里
points.body:
*Every act should be considered from the point of view not of its object but of its impulsion.* 问题不是「目的是什么」，而是「源头是什么」。

「我赤身露体，你们给我穿」，他们并不知道那是基督：*We must not know when we do such acts.*

*In general the expression ‘for God’ is a bad one. God ought not to be put in the dative.* *We should not go to our neighbour for the sake of God, but we should be impelled towards our neighbour by God, as the arrow is driven towards its target by the archer.*

*To be only an intermediary between the uncultivated ground and the ploughed field, between the data of a problem and the solution, between the blank page and the poem*，这对创作者是很亲切的一句：好东西往往*comes to us from outside, freely and by surprise as a gift from heaven*。

怎样知道上帝的意志？在内心造出安静，平息一切欲望和意见，带着爱默默地全心想着「愿你的旨意成就」，此后确信无疑应该做的事，就是上帝的意志。

*Action is the pointer of the balance. We must not touch the pointer but the weight.*

expressions.en: God makes himself necessity.
expressions.zh: 上帝使自己成为必然。

expressions.en: There was nothing else for it
expressions.zh: 没有别的办法（只能这么做）

expressions.en: God ought not to be put in the dative.
expressions.zh: 上帝不应该被放在与格里（不要说「为了上帝」）。

expressions.en: We must not touch the pointer but the weight.
expressions.zh: 不要拨动指针，而要改变砝码。

questions: 「只做不能不做的善行」，这会让人更消极还是更纯粹？
作为创作者，你有过「只是空白纸页与诗之间的中介」的体验吗？
「不要拨动指针，而要改变砝码」，在你改变自己的习惯时意味着什么？

lede: 我们被某物吸引，是因为相信它好；最后被它锁住，是因为它变得必需。幻觉不在事物的存在，而在我们赋予它的价值。真实的东西坚硬粗糙；令人愉快的属于梦。偶像崇拜则是一种生存必需：渴望绝对的善，却没有超自然的注意力和耐心去等待。

points.body:
*We are drawn towards a thing because we believe it is good. We end by being chained to it because it has become necessary.*

*Illusions about the things of this world do not concern their existence but their value.* 柏拉图的洞穴比喻说的是价值：我们只拥有善的影子。

*What is real in perception and distinguishes it from dreams is not the sensations, but the necessity enshrined in these sensations.*

*We must prefer real hell to an imaginary paradise.*

*A test of what is real is that it is hard and rough. Joys are found in it, not pleasure. What is pleasant belongs to dreams.*

*We must try to love without imagining—to love the appearance in its nakedness without interpretation. What we love then is truly God.*

*All the passions produce prodigies. A gambler is capable of watching and fasting almost like a saint.* *There is great danger in loving God as the gambler loves his game.*

她还批评「转移」：保留卑下的倾向（比如想胜过别人），只是把它附在高尚的对象上，就以为自己在上升。正确的做法相反：*rise by attaching noble inclinations to lowly objects.*

顺带一刀：*All the Freudian system is impregnated with the prejudice which it makes it its mission to fight—the prejudice that everything sexual is vile.*

*Idolatry comes from the fact that, while thirsting for absolute good, we do not possess the power of supernatural attention and we have not the patience to allow it to develop.*

*Idolatry is thus a vital necessity in the cave.* 每个人都愿意为所爱的东西而死，区别只在所爱之物的层次。

*Man would like to be an egoist and cannot. This is the most striking characteristic of his wretchedness and the source of his greatness.* *There is humility in us—only we humiliate ourselves before false gods.*

expressions.en: We must prefer real hell to an imaginary paradise.
expressions.zh: 我们必须宁要真实的地狱，而不要想象的天堂。

expressions.en: A test of what is real is that it is hard and rough.
expressions.zh: 检验真实的标准是它坚硬而粗糙。

expressions.en: Idolatry is thus a vital necessity in the cave.
expressions.zh: 所以在洞穴里，偶像崇拜是一种生存的必需。

expressions.en: Man would like to be an egoist and cannot.
expressions.zh: 人想做个利己主义者，却做不到。

questions: 你生活中有什么东西，从「因为好而被吸引」变成了「因为必需而被锁住」？
「真实的东西坚硬粗糙，愉快的属于梦」，这对你判断作品或关系有用吗？
你现在的「偶像」是什么？它在帮你还是在挡你？

lede: 爱是我们贫乏的标志：上帝只能爱他自己，而我们只能爱别的东西。相信他人的存在本身就是爱。纯粹地爱，就是同意距离，崇拜我们与所爱之间的那段距离。友谊应当是白白得来的喜乐，而不是被渴求的东西。

points.body:
*Love is a sign of our wretchedness. God can only love himself. We can only love something else.*

*Among human beings, only the existence of those we love is fully recognized.* *Belief in the existence of other human beings as such is love.*

她又一次用盲人手杖的比喻：手被绑在棍子上、眼被蒙住，棍子把我和物隔开，我却能借它探索它们。

*Love needs reality. What is more terrible than the discovery that through a bodily appearance we have been loving an imaginary being.*

她说，从所爱之人那里寻求（或想给予）艺术作品能给的安慰之外的安慰，是一种怯懦。

两种爱的形式：幸福的人爱不幸的人，是想分担他的苦；不幸的人爱幸福的人，是仅仅知道对方幸福就满心喜悦，而不去分享那份幸福。

*The beautiful is that which we cannot wish to change. To assume power over is to soil. To possess is to soil.*

*To love purely is to consent to distance, it is to adore the distance between ourselves and that which we love.*

她把贞洁定义为欲望的方向：*in love there is chastity or the lack of chastity according to whether the desire is or is not directed towards the future.*

*Learn to thrust friendship aside, or rather the dream of friendship. To desire friendship is a great fault. Friendship should be a gratuitous joy like those afforded by art or life.*

*Do not allow yourself to be imprisoned by any affection. Keep your solitude.* 真正的感情如果有一天到来，它和孤独并不矛盾。

这些话很严苛，也可以理解为对执着的警惕：让友谊成为礼物，而不是需要被填满的空。

expressions.en: Belief in the existence of other human beings as such is love.
expressions.zh: 相信他人作为他人而存在，就是爱。

expressions.en: To possess is to soil.
expressions.zh: 占有就是玷污。

expressions.en: to adore the distance between ourselves and that which we love
expressions.zh: 崇拜我们与所爱之间的距离

expressions.en: Friendship should be a gratuitous joy
expressions.zh: 友谊应当是一份白白得来的喜乐

questions: 「相信他人的存在就是爱」，你在什么时候真正「相信」过一个人的存在？
「崇拜距离」和「保持冷漠」有什么区别？
你同意「渴求友谊是一种过错」吗？这句话在什么情况下是对的？

lede: 想象中的恶浪漫多样，真实的恶阴郁单调、贫瘠乏味；想象中的善乏味，真实的善新奇美妙。罪是恶的转移：发脾气时，我们把自己的堕落传给别人。薇依的办法是把恶从不纯的部分转到纯的部分，把它变成纯粹的痛苦。

points.body:
*Creation: good broken up into pieces and scattered throughout evil.*

*Evil is limitless but it is not infinite. Only the infinite limits the limitless.* *Monotony of evil: never anything new.*

这一句对写作者特别有用：*Imaginary evil is romantic and varied; real evil is gloomy, monotonous, barren, boring. Imaginary good is boring; real good is always new, marvellous, intoxicating.* *Therefore ‘imaginative literature’ is either boring or immoral (or a mixture of both).*

*All crime is a transference of the evil in him who acts to him who undergoes the result of the action.* 我们发脾气时，身边的人也会跟着发脾气。

*The false God changes suffering into violence. The true God changes violence into suffering.*

*Patience consists in not transforming suffering into crime. That in itself is enough to transform crime into suffering.*

她引了《卡拉马佐夫兄弟》里伊万的话：即使这座巨大的工厂能造出最惊人的奇迹，只要代价是一个孩子的一滴眼泪，我也拒绝。

*I am in complete agreement with this sentiment. No reason whatever which anyone could produce to compensate for a child’s tear would make me consent to that tear.*

可她接着说：我们必须通过恶本身去爱上帝，*to love God through the evil we hate, while hating this evil*。*Evil is to love, what mystery is to the intelligence.*

*That which gives more reality to beings and things is good, that which takes it from them is evil.*

罗马人抢走希腊城市的雕像，是恶，因为那些城市、神庙和希腊人的生活，没了雕像就少了现实。

*The extreme affliction which overtakes human beings does not create human misery, it merely reveals it.* 我们惊讶苦难没有让人变得高贵，是因为想到受苦者时，我们想的是苦难，而不是那个人。

expressions.en: Evil is limitless but it is not infinite.
expressions.zh: 恶是无边的，但不是无限的。

expressions.en: Imaginary evil is romantic and varied; real evil is gloomy, monotonous, barren, boring.
expressions.zh: 想象的恶浪漫多变；真实的恶阴郁、单调、贫瘠、无聊。

expressions.en: The false God changes suffering into violence. The true God changes violence into suffering.
expressions.zh: 假神把痛苦变成暴力，真神把暴力变成痛苦。

expressions.en: Patience consists in not transforming suffering into crime.
expressions.zh: 忍耐就是不把痛苦变成罪。

questions: 你认同「真实的恶单调，真实的善新奇」吗？这对你看小说、电影、游戏有什么影响？
「不把痛苦变成罪」，在日常生活里具体是什么样？
一边赞同伊万拒绝孩子的眼泪，一边说要「通过恶去爱上帝」，你怎么看这个张力？

lede: 「苦难」（affliction，法语 malheur）是薇依的核心词，不只是痛苦，而是身体、灵魂和社会层面的同时碾压。基督教的伟大不在于给苦难找超自然的药，而在于给它找超自然的用处。然后是暴力和十字架：拿剑的必死于剑，不拿剑的死于十字架。

points.body:
*I should not love my suffering because it is useful. I should love it because it is.*

*We should seek neither to escape suffering nor to suffer less, but to remain untainted by suffering.*

*The extreme greatness of Christianity lies in the fact that it does not seek a supernatural remedy for suffering but a supernatural use for it.*

她也很清醒：*We should make every effort we can to avoid affliction*，这样遇到的苦难才是纯粹的。这不是鼓励受苦。

*Joy is the overflowing consciousness of reality.* 但在保持现实意识的同时受苦更好。

*Time does us violence; it is the only violence.* 苦难的特征之一是时间被打碎：罪犯、妓女、奴隶都是如此；雷诺工厂里的白俄工人也是。她说两种想法能稍减苦难：要么它马上就结束，要么它永远不会结束。

第十七章很短。*Death is the most precious thing which has been given to man. That is why the supreme impiety is to make a bad use of it.*

*We must strive to substitute more and more in this world effective non-violence for violence.* 她说非暴力只有在有效时才有用，并且*We should strive to become such that we are able to be non-violent.*

战争中：*never to inflict death without accepting it for ourselves.*

*Whoever takes up the sword shall perish by the sword. And whoever does not take up the sword (or lets it go) shall perish on the cross.*

基督治病、复活死人，是他使命中谦卑的、人的部分；超自然的部分是客西马尼园的血汗和十字架上的呼喊：*‘My God, my God, why has thou forsaken me?’* *There we have the real proof that Christianity is something divine.*

*There are people for whom everything is salutary which brings God nearer to them. For me it is everything which keeps him at a distance.* 这是她「否定之路」最清晰的自白。

expressions.en: a supernatural use for it
expressions.zh: 为苦难找到超自然的用处

expressions.en: Joy is the overflowing consciousness of reality.
expressions.zh: 喜乐是对现实满溢的意识。

expressions.en: Time does us violence; it is the only violence.
expressions.zh: 时间对我们施暴；这是唯一的暴力。

expressions.en: For me it is everything which keeps him at a distance.
expressions.zh: 对我来说，有益的是一切让他保持距离的东西。

questions: 「不要逃避痛苦，也不要求少受苦，而要不被痛苦玷污」，这在实际生活中可能吗？
「时间是唯一的暴力」，你在什么时候最强烈地感受到这一点？
薇依说十字架上的被弃之苦证明了基督教的神性，你怎么理解这种反直觉的说法？

titleEn: Balance and Lever · The Impossible · Contradiction · The Distance Between the Necessary and the Good
titleZh: 天平与杠杆，不可能，矛盾，以及必然与善之间的距离
lede: 四个短章是薇依的「逻辑」部分。十字架是天平和杠杆：向下是向上的条件。人生是不可能的，只有苦难让我们感觉到这一点；不可能是超自然的门。矛盾是实在的标准。而必然与善之间的距离，就是被造物与造物主之间的距离。

points.body:
*The cross as a balance, as a lever. A going down, the condition of a rising up.* *A lever. We lower when we want to lift.*

数学也有它的必然：*One—the smallest of the numbers.* 一个不断增大的数以为自己在接近无限，其实在远离它。*If I is God, ∞ is the devil.*

*We must not judge. We must be like the Father in heaven who does not judge: by him beings judge themselves.*

*Human life is impossible. But it is only affliction which makes us feel this.* 欲望毁掉它的对象：恋人不能合一，纳喀索斯不能成为两个。

*Our life is impossibility, absurdity. Everything we want contradicts the conditions or the consequences attached to it.*

*Impossibility is the door of the supernatural. We can but knock at it. It is someone else who opens.* *There is no impossibility in dreams—only impotence.*

她把善行和艺术灵感相比：好诗是在注意力始终指向不可表达的灵感时写成的。

*The contradictions the mind comes up against—these are the only realities: they are the criterion of the real. There is no contradiction in what is imaginary.*

一个方法论建议：*as soon as we have thought something, try to see in what way the contrary is true.* 编者注说，这句话是理解她全部「矛盾」的钥匙。

好的对立统一发生在更高的层面上，坏的则在同一层面上妥协。*The simultaneous existence of opposite virtues in the soul—like pincers to catch hold of God.* *Evil is the shadow of good.*

*Necessity is God’s veil.*

*The distance between the necessary and the good is the distance between the creature and the creator.* 这是希腊人的伟大发现（柏拉图）。

*Every attempt to justify evil by anything other than the fact that that which is is, is an offence against this truth.* 这句话否定了一切「苦难是为了更大的善」的神正论。*Limitation is the evidence that God loves us.*

expressions.en: We lower when we want to lift.
expressions.zh: 想抬起时，我们向下压。

expressions.en: Impossibility is the door of the supernatural.
expressions.zh: 不可能是超自然的门。

expressions.en: try to see in what way the contrary is true
expressions.zh: 试着看看反面在什么意义上也为真

expressions.en: Necessity is God’s veil.
expressions.zh: 必然是上帝的面纱。

questions: 「想到一个观点后，立刻去看它的反面怎样为真」，试着用这个方法想一个你最近的判断。
你同意「梦里没有不可能，只有无能」吗？
「除了『存在即存在』，任何为恶辩护的理由都是冒犯」，这比传统神正论更有说服力还是更冷酷？

titleEn: Chance · He Whom We Must Love is Absent · Atheism as a Purification
titleZh: 偶然，那必须被爱者是缺席的，以及作为净化的无神论
lede: 我爱的人都是偶然生下的，我与他们的相遇也是偶然，他们会死。我要全心知道这一点，却不因此少爱他们。上帝只能以缺席的形式在世上：所以我们必须在沙漠里，因为那必须被爱者是缺席的。由此，某一种无神论反而是对上帝观念的净化。

points.body:
*The beings I love are creatures. They were born by chance. My meeting with them was also by chance. They will die.* *I have to know this with all my soul and not love them the less.*

*Meditation on chance which led to the meeting of my father and mother is even more salutary than meditation on death.*

*The vulnerability of precious things is beautiful because vulnerability is a mark of existence.* 繁星与开花的果树：*utter permanence and extreme fragility give an equal sense of eternity.*

points.h: 上帝以缺席的方式在场
points.body:
*God can only be present in creation under the form of absence.*

*Evil is the innocence of God.* 要把上帝放在无限远处，才能设想他对恶是无辜的。

*We have to be in a desert. For he whom we must love is absent.* *Nothing which exists is absolutely worthy of love. We must therefore love that which does not exist.* 她强调这个不存在的爱的对象并不是虚构。

上帝不偏不倚地把苦难降给恶人和好人，就像他降下阳光和雨。*To explain suffering is to console it; therefore it must not be explained.*

《伊利亚特》里贯穿始终的呼喊是「为什么？」。在我们最需要一个有意义的声音时，回答我们的只有沉默，那就是上帝的沉默。

她甚至说：*I must love being nothing. How horrible it would be if I were something!*

*A case of contradictories which are true. God exists: God does not exist.* 我确信有一位上帝，因为我确信我的爱不是幻觉；我也确信没有上帝，因为我确信任何我能想象的东西都不像他。

*There are two atheisms of which one is a purification of the notion of God.* *Of two men who have no experience of God, he who denies him is perhaps nearer to him than the other.*

*Religion in so far as it is a source of consolation is a hindrance to true faith: in this sense atheism is a purification.*

expressions.en: vulnerability is a mark of existence
expressions.zh: 脆弱是存在的标志

expressions.en: God can only be present in creation under the form of absence.
expressions.zh: 上帝只能以缺席的形式在创造中在场。

expressions.en: To explain suffering is to console it; therefore it must not be explained.
expressions.zh: 解释苦难就是安慰它，所以不能解释它。

expressions.en: There are two atheisms of which one is a purification of the notion of God.
expressions.zh: 有两种无神论，其中一种是对上帝观念的净化。

questions: 想到父母相遇的偶然，对你有什么触动？
「解释苦难就是安慰它」，你在安慰别人时，有没有说过不该说的解释？
你怎么理解「否认上帝的人也许比另一个人更接近他」？

titleEn: Attention and Will · Training · Intelligence and Grace
titleZh: 注意力与意志，训练，以及智识与神恩
lede: 这三章是薇依最实用的部分。要用注意力而不是意志来改正缺点；意志只控制几块肌肉的几个动作。纯粹的注意力就是祈祷，也是人的创造力所在。然后是自我训练的方法，以及智识的谦卑：听巴赫或格里高利圣咏时，灵魂的一切能力都安静下来去理解。

points.body:
*We have to try to cure our faults by attention and not by will.*

*Attention, taken to its highest degree, is the same thing as prayer. It presupposes faith and love.* *Absolutely unmixed attention is prayer.*

*Extreme attention is what constitutes the creative faculty in man and the only extreme attention is religious.* 一个文明的创造天才，与它的极端注意力成正比。

把注意力死死盯在问题上，是另一种对空的恐惧。*By pulling at the bunch, we make all the grapes fall to the ground.*

*It is only effort without desire (not attached to an object) which infallibly contains a reward.*

理解象征的方法：*Not to try to interpret them, but to look at them till the light suddenly dawns.* *a method for the exercise of the intelligence, which consists of looking.*

关于创作：*The poet produces the beautiful by fixing his attention on something real.* *Teaching should have no aim but to prepare, by training the attention, for the possibility of such an act.*

*We have to accomplish the possible in order to touch the impossible.*

每次发现自己不由自主地生出骄傲的念头，就用几秒钟全神注视自己的某段可耻回忆。我们不能试图抹去欲望与厌恶，而要被动地承受它们；但也可以有限度地、像驯狗那样，对自己施加一点暴力，前提是基于理性。

她对自己的诊断：因为精疲力竭、缺乏生命能量，*I am below the level of normal activity*。*Duty is given us in order to kill the self—and I allow so precious an instrument to grow rusty.*

*We know by means of our intelligence that what the intelligence does not comprehend is more real than what it does comprehend.*

*When we listen to Bach or to a Gregorian melody, all the faculties of the soul become tense and silent in order to apprehend this thing of perfect beauty.* 信仰不也应该是这样一种「依附」吗？

*We have not to choose between opinions. We have to welcome them all but arrange them vertically, placing them on suitable levels.* 例如：偶然、命运、天意。

*Science, today, will either have to seek a source of inspiration higher than itself or perish.*

expressions.en: We have to try to cure our faults by attention and not by will.
expressions.zh: 要用注意力而不是意志来治愈我们的缺点。

expressions.en: Absolutely unmixed attention is prayer.
expressions.zh: 绝对纯粹的注意力就是祈祷。

expressions.en: By pulling at the bunch, we make all the grapes fall to the ground.
expressions.zh: 揪着整串葡萄拉，葡萄就全掉在地上了。

expressions.en: arrange them vertically, placing them on suitable levels
expressions.zh: 把意见纵向排列，放在合适的层次上

questions: 你有没有试过用「注意」而不是「强迫」来改掉一个习惯？
「看，直到光突然出现」，这和你学一首曲子、看一幅画的方式有什么相似？
听巴赫时灵魂「紧绷而安静」，你在什么音乐里有过这种体验？

lede: 薇依所说的「阅读」（lecture）不是读书，而是我们对一切事物的情感性诠释：看见一个人，就「读」出了他是什么。正义就是随时准备承认：别人可能和我们读出的完全不同。古格斯的戒指则讲另一种恶：我们把不想面对的联系「放到一边」，于是心安理得。

points.body:
编者注解释：这个词指 *emotional interpretation, the concrete judgment of value*。比如我在黑暗中看到一块白色的东西，就「读」出那是一个鬼魂。

*Every being cries out silently to be read differently.* 每一个存在都在无声地呼喊，要求被换一种方式阅读。

*Justice. To be ever ready to admit that another person is something quite different from what we read when he is there (or when we think about him).*

错读的原因：公众舆论与激情。*Joan of Arc: those who declaim about her today would nearly all have condemned her.*

*Reading—except where there is a certain quality of attention—obeys the law of gravity.* 更高质量的注意力让我们读出层层叠加的意义：*To read necessity behind sensation, to read order behind necessity, to read God behind order.*

*‘Judge not’: Christ himself does not judge. He is our judgment. Suffering innocence is the measure.*

古格斯的戒指出自柏拉图《理想国》：戴上它就能隐身，牧羊人古格斯借此杀王夺位。

薇依把它理解为 *setting aside*：*Gyges: ‘I have become king, and the other king has been assassinated.’ No connexion whatever between these two things.* 工厂主也是这样：我享受昂贵的奢侈，我的工人贫困不堪，他可能真诚地同情工人，却从不把两件事联系起来。

*For no connexion is formed if thought does not bring it about.*

*We hate the people who try to make us form the connexions we do not want to form.*

她说自己日复一日拖延某个义务时，也在用这把钥匙。*There is nothing more desirable than to get rid of this key. It should be thrown to the bottom of a well whence it can never again be recovered.*

*The act of throwing away the key, of throwing away the ring of Gyges—this is the effort proper to the will.* 意志在这里终于有了它真正的用武之地。

expressions.en: Every being cries out silently to be read differently.
expressions.zh: 每一个存在都在无声地呼喊，要被以不同的方式阅读。

expressions.en: Suffering innocence is the measure.
expressions.zh: 受苦的无辜者就是尺度。

expressions.en: setting aside
expressions.zh: 放到一边（逃避把事情联系起来）

expressions.en: No connexion whatever between these two things.
expressions.zh: 这两件事之间毫无联系。（自欺的逻辑）

questions: 你最近一次「读错」一个人是什么时候？
你生活中有什么「两件事之间毫无联系」，其实是被你放到一边的？
「我们讨厌那些逼我们建立联系的人」，这句话让你想到了谁或什么作品？

titleEn: Meaning of the Universe · Metaxu · Beauty · Algebra
titleZh: 宇宙的意义，中介，美，以及代数
lede: 我们是要模仿整体的部分：让整个宇宙成为我们的身体，就像盲人的手杖成为他的手。被造之物的本质是「中介」（metaxu）：墙把两个囚徒隔开，也让他们敲墙通信。美是偶然与善的和谐，距离是美的灵魂。最后一章转向现代文明的三个怪物：金钱、机械化、代数。

points.body:
*We are a part which has to imitate the whole.*

*Let the whole universe be for me, in relation to my body, what the stick of a blind man is in relation to his hand.* 就像学徒期改变了工人与工具的关系，*We do not become detached, we change our attachment. We must attach ourselves to the all.*

*It is better to say ‘I am suffering’ than ‘this landscape is ugly’.*

*All created things refuse to be for me as ends. Such is God’s extreme mercy towards me.*

*Two prisoners whose cells adjoin communicate with each other by knocking on the wall. The wall is the thing which separates them but it is also their means of communication.*

*No human being should be deprived of his metaxu, that is to say of those relative and mixed blessings (home, country, traditions, culture, etc.) which warm and nourish the soul.* 什么是亵渎？不是毁掉低的或高的，而是毁掉中间那些介于两者之间的东西。

*Beauty is the harmony of chance and the good.* *Beauty captivates the flesh in order to obtain permission to pass right to the soul.*

*The beautiful is that which we can contemplate.* 格里高利圣咏可以连唱几个小时。*Distance is the soul of the beautiful.* *Beauty: a fruit which we look at without trying to seize it.*

给音乐人的一段：*This movement of descent, the mirror of grace, is the essence of all music.* 音符的上升只是感官的上升，下降则同时是感官和精神的下降。*The beautiful is the experimental proof that the incarnation is possible.*

*Money, mechanization, algebra. The three monsters of contemporary civilization.* *Algebra and money are essentially levellers.*

符号与被指之物的关系正在被摧毁，符号之间的交换游戏被无限扩大。*There is no collective thought.* 但我们的科学和技术是集体的，思想于是转移到符号和机器里。

*The spirit, overcome by the weight of quantity, has no longer any other criterion than efficiency.* 写于 1940 年代，读来仍像是在说今天。

expressions.en: We must attach ourselves to the all.
expressions.zh: 我们必须依恋于全体。

expressions.en: The wall is the thing which separates them but it is also their means of communication.
expressions.zh: 墙把他们隔开，也是他们交流的途径。

expressions.en: Distance is the soul of the beautiful.
expressions.zh: 距离是美的灵魂。

expressions.en: Money, mechanization, algebra. The three monsters of contemporary civilization.
expressions.zh: 金钱、机械化、代数：当代文明的三个怪物。

questions: 你生活中的「中介」（metaxu）是什么？家、语言、某种传统、某种音乐？
「下降是一切音乐的本质」，你在自己的作曲里感受到过吗？
薇依担心「效率成为唯一标准」，你在今天的创作环境里怎么看这个问题？

titleEn: The Social Imprint · Israel · The Great Beast · Social Harmony
titleZh: 社会的烙印，以色列，巨兽，以及社会和谐
lede: 薇依的社会思想：人之所以是奴隶，是因为在行动与结果之间，隔着别人的意志。社会是柏拉图所说的「巨兽」，是唯一的偶像崇拜对象。民族不能成为超自然之爱的对象，但一个国家可以作为扎根的环境被爱。**内容提示**：「以色列」一章包含对犹太教和犹太民族的严厉、带有偏见的论断，长期饱受批评。

points.body:
*Man is a slave in so far as between action and its effect, between effort and the finished work, there is the interference of alien wills.*

*To have to deal directly with things frees the spirit. To have to deal directly with men debases us if we are dependent.* *Why these men between Nature and me?*

*We must always consider men in power as dangerous things.* 她认为社会生活应尽量消除苦难，因为苦难只对神恩有用，而社会不是圣徒的团体。

**内容提示与阅读提醒**：薇依出身犹太家庭，却在这一章（写于 1942 年前后）对希伯来圣经中的上帝和以色列民族作出极其严厉的论断，例如把以色列与罗马并称为「巨兽」，并把基督教中她厌恶的成分（进步观念、历史的「神圣教育」）归咎于犹太源头。这些论断在今天普遍被视为带有反犹偏见，学者们对其成因（时代背景、她的自我认同、她对一切「集体宗教」的敌意）也有很多讨论。

版权页显示，这一章的英译是 2002 年才由 Mario von der Ruhr 补译的。导读不复述其中的论断，建议带着批判的距离去读：它更多暴露的是薇依思想的盲点，而不是关于犹太教的知识。

*The Great Beast is the only object of idolatry, the only ersatz of God* 这个比喻来自柏拉图《理想国》：驯兽人研究一头巨兽的喜怒，把它喜欢的叫做「好」。

*The vegetative and the social are the two realms where the good does not enter.* *A Pharisee is someone who is virtuous out of obedience to the Great Beast.*

*But a nation as such cannot be the object of supernatural love. It has no soul. It is a Great Beast.* 不过一座城市作为人的环境，就像人呼吸的空气，*Rootedness lies in something other than the social.*

*It is impossible for an order which is higher and therefore infinitely above another to be represented in it except by something infinitely small.* 就像切线与圆的接触点。*Christ is the point of tangency between humanity and God.*

*Equilibrium alone destroys and annuls force.* 如果知道社会在哪边失衡，就要尽力给较轻的一边加砝码。

她对「进步」的批评：*The supreme atheistic idea is the idea of progress.* 而过去，*when we do not remanufacture it*，是唯一真实的东西：*there is more of eternity in the past than in the present.*

expressions.en: Why these men between Nature and me?
expressions.zh: 为什么在我与自然之间要隔着这些人？

expressions.en: the only object of idolatry, the only ersatz of God
expressions.zh: 巨兽是唯一的偶像崇拜对象

expressions.en: Rootedness lies in something other than the social.
expressions.zh: 扎根在于社会之外的东西。

expressions.en: Equilibrium alone destroys and annuls force.
expressions.zh: 只有平衡才能摧毁并抵消力量。

questions: 「在行动与结果之间隔着别人的意志」，你的工作里有这种「奴役」吗？
薇依认为民族不能被爱，但一个地方可以，你同意这个区分吗？
一位深刻的思想家也会有严重的偏见，这件事应当怎样影响我们读她的其余部分？

label: 39 · 后记
titleEn: The Mysticism of Work · Postscript, Fifty Years Later
titleZh: 劳动的神秘主义，以及五十年后的后记
lede: 全书以劳动收尾。薇依曾在工厂和农场干活，她说工人比任何人都更靠近上帝，因为他们没有任何尘世的目标挡在他们与上帝之间。工人需要诗胜过需要面包；奴役就是没有永恒之光的劳动。最后是蒂邦 1990 年写的一页后记。

points.body:
*Man’s greatness is always to recreate his life, to recreate what is given to him, to fashion that very thing which he undergoes.* *Through work he produces his own natural existence.*

两项任务：让机器个人化，让科学个人化（一种苏格拉底式的大众大学，学习各门手艺的基础知识）。

*Why has there never been a mystic, workman or peasant, to write on the use to be made of disgust for work.*

*Disgust in all its forms is one of the most precious trials sent to man as a ladder by which to rise. I have a very large share of this favour.*

*Monotony is the most beautiful or the most atrocious thing. The most beautiful if it is a reflection of eternity—the most atrocious if it is the sign of an unvarying perpetuity.* *The circle is the symbol of monotony which is beautiful, the swinging of a pendulum of monotony which is atrocious.*

劳动让我们最疲惫地体验目的的反弹：为吃饭而工作，为工作而吃饭。*Only the cycle contains the truth.*

*A squirrel turning in its cage and the rotation of the celestial sphere—extreme misery and extreme grandeur.* *It is when man sees himself as a squirrel turning round and round in a circular cage that, if he does not lie to himself, he is close to salvation.*

*No terrestrial finality separates the workers from God. They alone are so situated.*

*Workers need poetry more than bread. They need that their life should be a poem. They need some light from eternity.*

*It is not religion but revolution which is the opium of the people.* *Slavery is work without any light from eternity, without poetry, without religion.*

*No poetry concerning the people is authentic if fatigue does not figure in it, and the hunger and thirst which come from fatigue.*

蒂邦的后记只有几段：真正的光不会褪色，这本书是*a message from eternity, addressed to eternal man*，写给那个被重负奴役、被神恩解放的人。

expressions.en: Monotony is the most beautiful or the most atrocious thing.
expressions.zh: 单调是最美的东西，也可能是最残酷的东西。

expressions.en: Only the cycle contains the truth.
expressions.zh: 只有这个循环包含真理。

expressions.en: Workers need poetry more than bread.
expressions.zh: 工人需要诗胜过需要面包。

expressions.en: It is not religion but revolution which is the opium of the people.
expressions.zh: 人民的鸦片不是宗教，而是革命。

questions: 在重复的练习或工作里，你体验过哪一种单调：圆的单调还是钟摆的单调？
「工人需要诗胜过面包」，你作为创作者怎样看待这句话的责任？
读完全书，薇依的哪一个想法最可能改变你的日常？哪一个你最想反驳？
